authoritativeSources.role: Philosophy, IA, domain model, lifecycle, tokens, register, layout, accessibility
Component contracts (canonical naming authority), workspace recipe, screen briefs
Vocabulary + Sign Editor at full fidelity, design review, Project Picker specified-not-drawn

$meta.conflictRule: Design System wins on component naming; Foundations wins on tokens and IA; Scale Review wins on interaction at scale.
$meta.rule: If this document and a source document disagree, the source document wins and this document is wrong.

statusVocabulary.canonical-drawn: Drawn at full fidelity in a source document.
statusVocabulary.partially-drawn: Drawn in part; the remainder specified in prose.
statusVocabulary.specified-not-drawn: Contract complete, visual design deliberately absent. Buildable. Not a brief.
statusVocabulary.brief-only: A one-paragraph brief. A brief is not a design; these cannot be built beyond their shell.
statusVocabulary.component-specimen: A specimen of one component in situ, not a whole screen.

foundations.name: Product philosophy — 7 tenets, each with a stated cost

items.name: The content model is the product
items.cost: Slower to add ad-hoc features that do not fit the graph.

items.name: Authoring is a session, not a visit
items.cost: First-time users need real onboarding documentation, not a tour.

items.name: Nothing ships unreviewed
items.cost: Every write path carries versioning overhead from v1.

items.name: Content and models evolve separately
items.cost: Compatibility ranges must be expressed and tested explicitly.

items.name: Accessibility is a domain requirement
items.cost: Some dense visual shortcuts are unavailable to us.

items.name: AI proposes, a human disposes
items.cost: Suggestion review is real work, so accepting and rejecting must be almost free.

items.name: Media is training data
items.cost: Upload is a pipeline with failure states, not a file copy.

foundations.name: Explicit non-goals
items: Not a replacement for ML Studio

items.name: CONTENT
items.note: Authored per language; versioned as Language Packs.

items.name: DATA
items.note: Media, pose, annotations, datasets, splits. Cross-language.

items.name: MODELS
items.note: Trained in ML Studio, registered and evaluated here.

items.name: DISTRIBUTION
items.note: Releases bind a pack set to a channel with a compatibility range and a rollout.

items.name: Job
items.note: Cross-plane. Owns a scope, a stage list and an actor.

foundations.name: Domain model rules
items: 1:N scoped — nothing global except Media Assets and Model Packs
Reference, not ownership — Lessons reference Signs; deletion surfaces an impact list
Categories are facets, not a folder tree
Media is deduplicated; usage count shown before any destructive action
Versioning is per entity and per pack
Models never point at content — pairing happens only in a Release

foundations.name: Navigation frame — product rail + scope bar + contextual sidebar
rejected: Flat global sidebar with language as a filter

foundations.name: URL contract
foundations.rule: Every list state (filters, sort, columns, page) is URL-encoded. Saved views are named URLs.

foundations.name: Editorial lifecycle — 6 states, 9 guarded transitions
invariants: A published revision is never mutated
Approval is bound to a revision, not an entity
Bulk transitions are logged individually with a single undo for the batch
Stale review is a badge on the review record, not a state
foundations.note: Not configurable, by decision. A seventh state would be added to the system once, for everyone.

foundations.name: AI workflow — 4 non-negotiable rules

items.name: Never a silent write
items.note: Model output enters as a suggestion. No exceptions, including bulk.

items.name: Always attributed
items.note: Model version, confidence at the time, and who accepted it.

items.name: Confidence is a number
items.note: Shown numerically with its threshold and reasons. Never a bare colour.

items.name: AI cannot block
items.note: Only deterministic rules can stop a publish.

provenance.note: Excluded from packs and training sets.
The most valuable training signal — the delta is retained.

foundations.placement: AI is not a rail entry. It appears inside the work.

foundations.name: ML asset record — 5 field groups, 7-stage ingest
foundations.note: Failure is a stage state; retry resumes rather than restarts.

foundations.name: Model registry — immutable versions, mandatory card
foundations.gate: A version with an empty limitations section cannot be promoted past beta.
foundations.yankRule: A yanked version is withdrawn from distribution but remains readable. Nothing is ever deleted from the registry.

foundations.name: Distribution — 7-step pipeline, 4 channels, compatibility matrix
foundations.note: Untested is explicit, never a blank — a blank cell reads as safe.

foundations.name: Validation model — 4 severities, 15-rule catalogue
foundations.antiNoise: Any rule producing results on more than 30% of a scope is flagged as miscalibrated to an Administrator rather than shown to every editor.

foundations.name: Search and palette — 6 modes, ranking and safety rules
ranking: Scoped results first, cross-language below a labelled divider, never silently mixed
Your own recent edits outrank global popularity
Destructive and approval-gated actions are labelled and never the default highlighted row
Actions the current role cannot perform are shown but disabled with the reason

foundations.name: Operational health — 6 figures, 6 rules, 6-card cap
foundations.note: Learner analytics explicitly deferred to a second tab.

tokens.name: text.tertiary
tokens.meaning: Metadata and labels. 5.4:1 on white, 4.9:1 on subtle and selected surfaces — passes AA on every ground in the system. Never for body copy.

tokens.name: accent.ai
tokens.meaning: AI/ML domain only. Same lightness as accent.

tokens.name: control.disabled.bg
tokens.meaning: Disabled control ground. Never a dimmed version of the enabled fill.

tokens.name: control.disabled.fg
tokens.meaning: Disabled control label. 4.6:1 on control.disabled.bg — a disabled control must still be readable.

tokens.name: icon.subtle
tokens.meaning: Resting state of non-text affordances: row menus, unstarred views, chevrons. 3.3:1 on every surface — WCAG 1.4.11 floor for UI components.

tokens.name: status.neutral.fg
tokens.meaning: Draft, deprecated, unset. The absence of a signal is itself a state.

tokens.name: status.warning.fg
tokens.meaning: Changes requested, non-blocking validation, degraded compatibility.

tokens.name: accent.subtle
tokens.meaning: Selected rows, active nav, accent-tinted grounds. Same value as surface.selected by intent, not coincidence.

tokens.name: accent.ai.subtle
tokens.meaning: Suggestion wrappers, ghost annotation lanes, advisory findings.

tokens.name: accent.ai.border
tokens.meaning: Border companion for the AI register.

tokens.name: viz.track
tokens.meaning: Unfilled portion of any quantitative bar. The only neutral in the viz ramp.

tokens.name: viz.fill.default
tokens.meaning: At or above target — coverage, quality, rollout, budget.

tokens.name: viz.fill.danger
tokens.meaning: Below floor — landmark gaps, critical coverage shortfall.

tokens.name: viz.stroke.default
tokens.meaning: Segment edge on a filled span, so adjacent spans stay countable.

tokens.name: viz.stroke.ai
tokens.meaning: Dashed segment edge on suggested spans.

tokens.name: mono
tokens.meaning: IDs, glosses, versions, timecodes — never prose

tokens.name: radius.full
tokens.meaning: Avatar only; not referenced by any component contract (F8)

tokens.name: dur.fast
tokens.meaning: Popover and menu entry, tab change

tokens.name: dur.base
tokens.meaning: Drawer and sheet slide, dialog scale

tokens.name: bp.sm
tokens.meaning: Read and review only; editors disabled with an explanation

tokens.name: bp.md
tokens.meaning: Rail + one pane; sidebar and inspector become overlays

tokens.name: bp.lg
tokens.meaning: Rail + sidebar + content; inspector on demand — the design target

tokens.name: bp.xl
tokens.meaning: All panes visible; extra width goes to the data view

tokens.name: focus.ring
tokens.meaning: Rule stated in prose: 2px accent ring at 2px offset, never removed. No token trio exists (F9)

components.name: SyButton
components.purpose: Commits an action; the label is the verb, never a generic confirmation.
components.anatomy: label (required, verb) · optional leading icon · optional shortcut hint
components.loading: Label persists, spinner replaces the icon, aria-busy set, focus kept.
components.disabled: Uses control.disabled.bg/fg, still clears 3:1, always paired with a stated reason.
components.keyboard: Enter / Space; never a tabindex trap.
components.accessibility: Native button; 32px hit area, 44px on touch; aria-busy when loading.

components.name: SyField
components.purpose: One labelled value of any type.
components.anatomy: visible label · control · helper or error text
components.validation: Invalid renders border + icon + text, never colour alone; message tied by aria-describedby.
components.keyboard: Tab order = visual order; Esc reverts an in-progress inline edit; ⌘S saves the form.
components.accessibility: Visible label always.

components.name: SyStatusBadge
components.purpose: Lifecycle state of any entity.
components.anatomy: glyph (aria-hidden) · label (accessible name) · optional modifier suffix
components.keyboard: Not interactive by default; as a filter chip it is a toggle button.
components.accessibility: Glyph aria-hidden; label is the accessible name; actor and time on focus, never colour-only.

components.name: SyEntityRef
components.purpose: A pointer to any entity. The single way one entity refers to another.
components.anatomy: type glyph · ID · name · state
components.loading: Loading state on the reference itself.
components.keyboard: Enter opens; ⌘Enter opens in a side peek without losing the current context.
components.accessibility: Accessible name = type + name + ID; state announced; never a bare ID link.

components.name: SyMetric
components.purpose: A figure with its denominator, trend and target.
components.anatomy: figure · denominator · trend · target · optional decorative bar
components.loading: Card keeps its title and denominator visible while the figure loads.
components.keyboard: Focusable when it links to its underlying list; Enter opens that list.
components.accessibility: Tabular figures; the denominator is part of the accessible name; bars are aria-hidden decoration.

components.name: SyStateBlock
components.purpose: Every non-populated state, anywhere.
components.anatomy: heading (real heading) · explanatory line · one named next action
components.keyboard: Its action receives focus on appearance only when the user's action caused the state.
components.accessibility: Heading is real; errors are assertive live regions, empties polite; no decorative illustration.

components.name: SyMenu
components.purpose: Contextual actions. Eight fixed groups in fixed order on every entity type.
components.anatomy: 8 groups: Open · Edit · Relate · Lifecycle · Validate · Duplicate · Copy link · Destructive (last)
components.disabled: Unpermitted items shown disabled with the reason.
components.keyboard: Esc closes; focus returns to trigger.
components.accessibility: menu role; destructive items last and labelled; shortcut shown per item.
components.composition: Contents come from the entity action registry, not per-screen code. Shares the overlay substrate (focus trap, Esc, stacking, focus restore) — that substrate is a hook, not a component.

components.name: SyDrawer
components.purpose: Work beside context, never on top of it.
components.anatomy: title · body · footer actions
components.keyboard: Esc closes; ⌘Enter submits.
components.accessibility: dialog role; labelled by title.

components.name: SyDialog
components.purpose: Blocking decisions only. The confirm button names the action and its count.
components.anatomy: title · body (impact preview as text) · named confirm + cancel
components.keyboard: Esc cancels; focus trapped and restored.
components.accessibility: alertdialog for destructive; impact preview is text, not a warning icon alone.
components.rule: Never a modal for work that takes more than one decision — that is a drawer or a workspace.

components.name: SyConfidence
components.purpose: Confidence figure with a band label and the threshold that applies.
components.anatomy: number (first) · band label · threshold · decorative bar
states: stale (computed by an older model version)
components.keyboard: Not independently interactive.
components.accessibility: Numeric value always in the accessible name; the bar is decorative and aria-hidden.
components.composition: Documented inside the SySuggestion article but independently usable — it appears in the asset grid with no suggestion present, so it is its own module.

components.name: SyAppShell
components.purpose: Rail, scope bar, sidebar, content, inspector.
components.anatomy: rail 60 · scope bar · sidebar 208–360 · content · inspector 280–420
components.keyboard: ⌥1…7 rail · ⌘L scope · ⌘\ toggle sidebar · ⌘/ toggle inspector · F6 cycles panes
components.accessibility: Each pane is a landmark with a name; skip links to content and inspector; scope changes announced assertively.
components.composition: Panes resizable, persisted per user. Owns responsive behaviour — no screen defines its own breakpoint handling.

components.name: SyEntityHeader
components.purpose: The primary entity, stated: identity, state, version, actor, one primary action.
components.anatomy: breadcrumb · title (document h1) · status badge · revision + actor · secondary actions · one primary action
components.loading: Title skeleton only — never a full-screen spinner; the entity identity is the first thing painted.
components.disabled: Blocked primary action rendered with control.disabled.* plus a banner naming the blocking rule and a fix link.
components.keyboard: Primary action has a named shortcut shown in the label; ⌘⌥C copies a deep link.
components.accessibility: The title is the document h1; breadcrumb is a nav landmark; state change is a live region.

components.name: SyTabSet
components.purpose: Facet navigation within a single entity. Each tab is a route segment, so every facet is deep-linkable.
components.anatomy: tab label · optional count badge
variants: overflowing (scrolls, never wraps to two rows)
components.disabled: Disabled tabs stay visible with their stated reason.
components.validation: A blocking count renders in status.danger and is in the accessible name.
components.keyboard: 1…n jump to tab; ← → traverse when focused; Home / End to the ends. Never traps arrow keys once focus leaves the tablist.
components.accessibility: tablist / tab / tabpanel; the active tab is the URL so browser back works.
components.composition: Owns navigation only, never content. Tab names and order are screen data.
reuse: Every L2 detail template: sign, asset, model version, lesson, release, dataset

components.name: SyInspector
components.purpose: Computed context for the focused entity.
components.anatomy: 4 universal sections in fixed order (State · Validation · Usage · History), then type-specific sections appended
components.keyboard: ⌘/ toggles; F6 enters; sections collapse with Enter on the header.
components.accessibility: Complementary landmark; section headers are real headings; collapse state announced.
components.composition: Type-specific sections are appended, never interleaved. Currently: Model view, Capture, Compatibility. Never the only path to a value.

components.name: SyCollection
components.purpose: Grid, filter bar, saved views, bulk bar and pagination as one composed unit.
components.anatomy: filter bar · saved views · bulk bar (in layout flow) · grid header · rows · footer
components.loading: Skeleton matching the real row grid at the remembered row count; filter bar and saved view stay interactive.
components.keyboard: J/K move · X select · ⇧J extend · E edit · Enter open · / filter · ⌘A all in view
components.accessibility: role=grid, arrow navigation, sort direction announced, selection count in a live region. aria-rowcount reflects the full match count, not the rendered window.
components.composition: Virtualised ~24 rows; server-side sort, filter and count. Hands a cursor to SyEntityHeader for walk selection.

components.name: SyMatrix
components.purpose: Any two-axis relationship with a small set of cell states.
components.anatomy: axis headers · cells (glyph + word) · legend · cell detail
components.keyboard: Arrow keys traverse; Enter opens cell detail; Home/End jump to axis ends.
components.accessibility: Glyph + word in every cell; headers associated both ways; a table fallback for screen readers.

components.name: SyPalette
components.purpose: Find, act, jump. The index of the product.
components.anatomy: input · ACTIONS / PINNED / RECENT sections · footer mode hints
components.disabled: Actions the current role cannot perform are shown but disabled with the reason.
components.keyboard: ⌘K scoped · ⇧⌘K global
components.accessibility: combobox pattern, aria-activedescendant listbox, focus trapped and restored.
components.composition: Reads the entity action registry. Empty query shows pinned then recents.

components.name: SySuggestion
components.purpose: Wraps any value a model produced.
components.anatomy: value · ✦ SUGGESTED tag · confidence + threshold + model version · Accept / Edit / Reject
components.validation: Suggested values are excluded from packs and training exports until accepted.
components.keyboard: ⌘⇧A accept · ⌘⇧X reject · Tab moves to the next suggestion, not the next field.
components.accessibility: Announced as a suggestion with its confidence; never focus-stealing; decisions confirmed politely.

components.name: SyTimeline
components.purpose: Frame-accurate lanes over a time-based asset.
components.anatomy: transport · time ruler · lanes (human / suggested / landmarks) · segment handles
components.keyboard: [ ] frame step · ⇧[ ⇧] segment step · L loop region · Space play · 0.25× speed floor
components.accessibility: Every segment focusable with a spoken time range and label; lanes also render as a table. No autoplay.

components.name: SyPipeline
components.purpose: Any ordered multi-stage process with per-stage state and a resumable failure.
components.anatomy: stage list · per-stage state · error + resume-from-here
components.keyboard: Each stage is a link; every stage is deep-linkable and resumable after a reload.
components.accessibility: Ordered list semantics; current stage marked aria-current; progress announced politely.
components.composition: Irreversible stages say so before they run. Stage state lives in the entity, not the session.

components.name: SyFindingList
components.purpose: Grouped rule outcomes with severity, count, affected entities and a resolution path.
components.anatomy: severity (first spoken token) · rule · count · affected entities as SyEntityRef · resolution action
components.loading: Running state per rule; rules report as they complete.
components.disabled: Blocking rules cannot be overridden by an Editor.
components.validation: Grouped by rule, not by entity. A rule that times out reports as partial, never silently omitted.
components.keyboard: ⌘⇧V run on scope · Enter jumps to the offending field · A acknowledges with a note
components.accessibility: Severity is the first spoken token; auto-fix states its scope before running; results are a landmark region.

components.name: SyVersionList
components.purpose: Immutable versions of anything.
components.anatomy: version · state · metrics with named split or baseline · deltas as text
components.loading: Metric tables stream per split with the split named while pending.
components.validation: A missing evaluation run shows as no-data with the run that would produce it, never as a zero.
components.keyboard: X marks two versions, C compares them, Enter opens the version
components.accessibility: Deltas carry sign and unit as text; the metric column always names its split or baseline.

patterns.name: Canvas authors, inspector reports
patterns.source: Sayva Studio Scale Review.dc.html Q3 / A1
patterns.rule: Typed values in the canvas, computed values in the inspector. No value appears in both on the same screen.

tests.canvas: If a reviewer could ask "who wrote this and why", it belongs in the canvas.
tests.inspector: If it is computed rather than typed, it belongs in the inspector.

patterns.appliedBy: Deleting the Sign Editor right column; Used by → Inspector Usage, Variants → its existing tab, Model view → Inspector type-specific section.

patterns.name: Inspector section order
patterns.rule: Four universal sections always first, in this fixed order. Type-specific sections are appended, never interleaved. History is always the fourth section.

patterns.name: Workspace recipe — five parts
tests: Can you name the primary entity in one word?
Can a user open, edit and publish that entity from here?
Does every secondary entity appear as a SyEntityRef, not a copy?
Is there exactly one primary action?
Does the screen introduce a component, or only assemble existing ones?
Would a professional spend an hour here without leaving?

patterns.name: Selection → queue
patterns.rule: Any selection can become a queue.
stages: SELECT — bulk bar offers two verbs
WALK — editor sidebar becomes the selection; position in the URL
RETURN — walked entities marked done, rest still selected
patterns.cap: ~200 working set with an explicit next batch
patterns.composition: SyCollection hands a cursor to SyEntityHeader. No new component.

patterns.name: Overlay selection rule

map.when: A decision that must not be missed

patterns.hardRule: Never a modal for work that takes more than one decision — that is a drawer or a workspace.

patterns.name: Contextual menu — eight groups, fixed order
patterns.rule: Identical on signs, assets, lessons, releases and datasets. Contents come from the entity action registry.

patterns.name: Queue continuity
patterns.rule: A list hands its ordering to the detail view; J/K keeps working after opening an entity. Position lives in the URL and survives reload.

patterns.name: AI visual register
patterns.rule: Violet (accent.ai), ✦ glyph, and a numeric confidence — never a lifecycle colour and never a status badge.

principles.name: Density with air where it counts
principles.forbids: Oversized cards, 24px paddings in data views, hero sections inside the app.

principles.name: One primary action per surface
principles.forbids: Two filled buttons in one toolbar; ambiguous verb pairs like Save and Apply.

principles.name: Show state, always
principles.forbids: Lists that show only a name; edits with no indication of what is unsaved.

principles.name: Destruction is reversible or explained
principles.forbids: "Are you sure?" dialogs with no information in them.

principles.name: Colour is never the only signal
principles.forbids: Red/green-only status dots; legends that map colour to meaning alone.

principles.name: The keyboard is a first-class input
principles.forbids: Drag-only reordering; hover-only affordances; unreachable focus traps.

principles.name: The system absorbs new features
principles.forbids: Bespoke page layouts; one-off components that duplicate an existing pattern.

principles.name: Machine output is labelled and reversible
principles.forbids: Silent AI writes; confidence as a colour bar with no number; suggestions that cannot be undone.

principles.name: Screens are workspaces, not pages
principles.forbids: Dashboard pages that summarise several unrelated things; screens whose title is a noun nobody can open, edit or publish.

principles.name: Every metric is a door
principles.forbids: Dashboard tiles that cannot be clicked; percentages with no denominator; charts nobody can act on.

workspaceRecipes.name: Vocabulary
workspaceRecipes.goal: Move a batch of signs toward publishable state: find what is incomplete, fix it or route it to someone who can.
workspaceRecipes.layout: SyAppShell three-pane. Rail 60 · sidebar 216 · inspector 292. Shell minimum 1560px.
workspaceRecipes.scope: Scope bar: language switcher (⌘L), palette (⌘K), blocking count, Activity tray (⌘J), avatar. Rail ⌥1–7.
workspaceRecipes.appBar: SyEntityHeader collection variant: breadcrumb, title, "4,812 signs · 318 shown", Import / ⋯ / New sign N
workspaceRecipes.selection: Selection bar in the layout flow, not floating. "3 selected · ⇧J extend · ⌘A all 318 · Walk selection ↵"
workspaceRecipes.inspector: Multi-select summary: Common fields · Validation across selection · Usage
workspaceRecipes.queues: Walk selection hands a cursor to the Sign editor.
workspaceRecipes.jobs: Bulk operations above 50 become jobs, reported in the Activity tray.

states.empty: First-run: import CSV or create first sign. Filtered-empty names the active filters.
states.loading: Row skeleton matching the real grid at the remembered row count.
states.error: SyStateBlock in the grid area with trace ID, filters preserved, retry.

workspaceRecipes.responsive: ≥1280 three panes · 900–1279 inspector overlays · <900 read-only summary list with a stated reason.

workspaceRecipes.goal: Bring one sign to a publishable standard: correct linguistic metadata, sound media, resolved review comments.

workspaceRecipes.scope: Scope bar with QUEUE indicator "7 of 37 in review · J / K".
workspaceRecipes.appBar: Breadcrumb · title · SyStatusBadge In Review · rev 14 · @nadia · 2h ago · Request changes / ⋯ / Approve ⌘⇧R (disabled)
workspaceRecipes.canvas: Gloss · Display name · Description wrapped in SySuggestion · Handshape/Movement/Location · Reference media panel with SyTimeline
workspaceRecipes.inspector: State · Validation · Usage · History · Model view — recognition-arsl 2.4.0
bulkActions: Replace an asset everywhere it is used
workspaceRecipes.queues: Walking selection sidebar: source view, "7 of 200 · ~12,400 remaining", J/K move, ⌘⇧R decide.
workspaceRecipes.jobs: Media operations and re-scoring run as jobs.

states.empty: New sign: only required fields, duplicate detection as the gloss is typed.
states.loading: Header title and status resolve first, then the active tab. Never a full-screen spinner.
states.error: Save conflict shows a field-level diff with keep-mine / take-theirs per field. Media failures are per-asset.

states.error: Ingest failures are a stage state on the asset, with resume-from-here. Upload errors are per file, never per batch.

workspaceRecipes.name: Validation Center
workspaceRecipes.goal: Get a scope to zero blocking findings, and keep warnings honest.
workspaceRecipes.scope: Scope is the subject of the entity header.
bulkActions: Auto-fix all instances of a rule (with a stated count)
Assign a rule's findings to an owner
workspaceRecipes.queues: The finding list is itself a queue.
workspaceRecipes.jobs: Bulk validation is always a job. Rules report as each completes.

states.empty: Clean scope states what was checked, how many rules ran and when.
states.loading: Rules report as they complete; each row shows its own running state.
states.error: A rule that times out is reported as partial with the entities it did cover, never silently omitted.

workspaceRecipes.responsive: Rule groups collapse to a severity-ordered list below 1280; jump-to-fix opens read-only below 900.

workspaceRecipes.name: Release Composer
workspaceRecipes.goal: Ship a known-good pack set to a channel, and be able to undo it in one action.
workspaceRecipes.layout: Persistent step list; each step deep-linkable and resumable.
bulkActions: Include/exclude whole categories, languages or model versions
Acknowledge all warnings with one note
Promote several channels in a controlled order
workspaceRecipes.jobs: Pack build and publish are always jobs. Stage state lives in the release, not the session.

states.empty: No releases yet: explains channels and what a first release requires.
states.loading: Each stage reports its own progress; resumable after a reload.
states.error: A failed stage keeps the release, names the stage, offers resume-from-here. Signing failures never leave a half-signed artefact in a channel.

workspaceRecipes.responsive: Step list becomes a horizontal stepper below 1280; rollout controls desktop-only with an explicit note.

workspaceRecipes.name: Operational Health
workspaceRecipes.goal: Answer one question in under a minute: is this scope in a shippable state, and if not, what is the next action.
workspaceRecipes.layout: Card grid reflowing 3 → 2 → 1 in priority order.
bulkActions: none — this screen commands nothing directly, it routes

states.empty: New scope: cards render with a no-data state naming what must exist before a figure is meaningful. Never a zero that reads as a failure.
states.loading: Cards resolve independently, each keeping its title and denominator visible.
states.error: A card that cannot compute says so with a retry, and does not fall back to a stale number without labelling it stale.

workspaceRecipes.responsive: Three columns → two → one. Works fully below 900px because it is read-and-route only.

workspaceRecipes.source: Sayva Studio Foundations.dc.html §11, Sayva Studio Design System.dc.html §Overlays
workspaceRecipes.goal: Find, act, jump. At fifty thousand entities across a hundred languages, search is the navigation.
workspaceRecipes.layout: elev.3 overlay: input · ACTIONS / PINNED / RECENT · footer mode hints
workspaceRecipes.scope: ⌘K scoped to current language · ⇧⌘K global across all languages

states.empty: Empty query shows pinned items then recents — the palette is useful before a keystroke.

screenSpecific: Ranking weights are UNSPECIFIED BY DESIGN

workspaceRecipes.name: Project Picker
workspaceRecipes.url: Application root. Adds no entry to the URL contract.
workspaceRecipes.goal: Get the author into the workspace they mean to work in, or into a new one, without asking them anything the filesystem already knows.
workspaceRecipes.layout: One column at every breakpoint. No rail, no scope bar, no sidebar, no inspector. Header, then list.
workspaceRecipes.scope: None. No scope bar — nothing here is language-scoped.
workspaceRecipes.appBar: Screen-local header: product name, the workspace-root line, and the single primary action New Project. Present in every state: with the list, and in first-run, loading and error. The workspace-root line reads "Studio is looking in {root}". Not SyEntityHeader.
workspaceRecipes.selection: None. Selection exists to enable bulk action; there is none.
workspaceRecipes.jobs: None. Create, open and duplicate are each a single small file operation.

states.empty: first-run: root empty or absent. Heading "No projects yet"; line "Studio is looking in {root}. A project is one .sayva file." The explanatory line names the location being listed. Temporary slice boundary: its New Project action arrives with the Create slice; until then no action renders, no substitute and no disabled button, and first-run is never replaced by a bare empty list.
states.loading: Skeleton, not spinner, while the scan is in flight. Accessible name: "Studio is looking in {root}".
states.error: Root unreadable: heading "Can't read the projects folder"; the line names the path, action Retry. Per-file: an unreadable .sayva renders as an inline-row error naming the file. Trace ID (AC14): Each failure to read the list gets its own trace ID when it happens — an identifier for that one occurrence, never reused and never a category. The same value is written with the failure's details to the server's own diagnostic output, so the Trace ID on screen leads to the record of what went wrong. It is not the file path, not the framework's error digest, and not stored anywhere: it exists only in the page state and that one diagnostic line. Create: a failed write shows the error state, panel size, inside the Create drawer below the name field — heading "Can't create the project"; the line names the location; Retry re-runs Create with the name in the field; a trace ID per occurrence, recorded as above. The drawer stays open and keeps the name.

workspaceRecipes.responsive: One column at all four breakpoints. bp.sm is read-and-open only, with New Project and Duplicate disabled and a stated reason. New Project's reason: "Creating a project needs a window at least 900px wide." The header's New Project stays visible and disabled; first-run renders no action. Content-column maximum width is NOT APPLICABLE — both candidate rules are scoped to the shell.
screenSpecific: The workspace-root line in the header

The updatedAt presentation: compact relative time (Nm / Nh / Nd / Nw ago, floored), with the machine value in a <time> element's datetime attribute. An updatedAt later than the moment the page renders counts as zero elapsed time, so it reads 0m ago.
The N shortcut for New Project — temporary slice boundary: arrives in a later slice
workspaceRecipes.blockedBy: Delete semantics (two canonical sources contradict); ArchiveProject; Created->Active trigger; workspace root path; tolerant repository read. None resolved by this design.

rules.name: Selection is a predicate
rules.definition: The client holds a filter plus exceptions, never an ID list. ⌘A selects the filtered set; every bulk action sends the predicate and the server resolves it once inside a transaction.

rules.name: Bulk edit semantics
rules.definition: Only fields the user touches are applied; untouched fields keep per-entity values. Mixed values are shown as mixed and left unchanged unless explicitly set.

rules.name: Walk selection
rules.definition: Any selection becomes an ordered cursor. Bulk bar offers two verbs. Working set capped at ~200 with an explicit next batch.

rules.name: Queue continuity
rules.definition: A list hands its ordering to the detail view; J/K continues working after opening an entity. Position lives in the URL and survives reload.

rules.name: Keyboard grammar
rules.definition: One vocabulary product-wide: J/K move, X select, ⇧J extend, E edit, Enter open, ⌘Enter side peek, / filter, Esc dismiss topmost, ⌥1–7 rail, ⌘L scope, ⌘/ inspector, ⌘\ sidebar, F6 pane cycle.

rules.name: Inline editing
rules.definition: One field, one keystroke, Enter commits, Esc reverts. Two or more fields opens the editor or a drawer instead.

rules.name: Inspector ownership
rules.definition: Canvas authors, inspector reports. Four universal sections in fixed order; type-specific appended, never interleaved.

rules.name: Lifecycle transitions
rules.definition: Six states, nine guarded transitions, one state machine for every content entity. Never optimistic — guards and permissions are server-side facts.

rules.name: Cardinality decides sync vs job
rules.definition: Same operation, same interface; only the feedback changes. Bulk edit ≤50 sync, above becomes a Job. Select-all-filtered, validation, publish, import, export and ingest are always jobs.

rules.name: Job is an entity
rules.definition: Every job has an ID, state, owner, history and deep link. Surfaced in an Activity tray (⌘J) in the scope bar. Job lists reuse SyCollection; job detail reuses SyPipeline.

rules.name: Optimistic boundary
rules.definition: Optimistic only where the client can deterministically compute the server's answer. Everything else shows a pending state.

rules.name: Validation blocking
rules.definition: Only deterministic rules block publishing. AI findings are advisory, carry a confidence figure, never auto-fix and are always dismissible. Blocking overrides are Administrator-only and logged with a reason.

rules.name: AI provenance
rules.definition: Four levels — human, suggested, accepted, corrected — recorded per value with model version and confidence at accept time. Suggested values are excluded from packs and training exports.

rules.name: Contextual menu
rules.definition: Eight groups in one fixed order on every entity type. Contents come from the entity action registry, not per-screen code.

rules.name: Command palette
rules.definition: Every action reachable on a screen is reachable from the palette, with its shortcut shown. Scoped results first, cross-language below a labelled divider. Unpermitted actions shown disabled with the reason.

rules.name: Virtualisation
rules.source: Sayva Studio Screens.dc.html §01, Sayva Studio Scale Review.dc.html Q1
rules.definition: ~24 rows rendered regardless of match count. Server-side sort, filter and count. Skeleton matches the real row grid at the remembered row count.

rules.name: Server-side aggregation
rules.definition: Exact counts below 10,000, approximate above with count-precisely on demand. Inspector aggregates up to 1,000 selected, then counts plus an explicit compute action. Denormalised columns are materialised projections.

rules.name: Group-by constraint
rules.definition: Offered only on facets with cardinality under ~200, declared per field in the schema. Unbounded fields appear as filters instead, and the column picker states why.

rules.name: Absence states
rules.definition: Six named states — first-run, filtered-empty, loading, error, no-permission, offline — written as content, not built per screen. Filtered-empty always names the active filters.

rules.name: Destructive actions
rules.source: Sayva Studio Foundations.dc.html §02 P4, Sayva Studio Screens.dc.html §02
rules.definition: Soft delete by default. Impact preview computed server-side from the graph and shown before confirmation. The confirm button names the action and count, never OK.

accessibility.requirement: Body text AAA where achievable, AA floor everywhere. text.tertiary is the lowest permitted for any text and only for metadata.
Disabled controls use control.disabled.* and clear 3:1. A greyed control that cannot be read is a defect, not a state.
Row menus, chevrons, checkboxes, toggles and unstarred icons use icon.subtle at 3.3:1 minimum (WCAG 1.4.11).
Every semantic pairing tested on all four surfaces: canvas, default, subtle, selected.
2px accent ring at 2px offset on every focusable element. Never removed.
Follows visual order. Pane order rail → sidebar → content → inspector, with F6 cycling and skip links.
Every overlay returns focus to its trigger on close. Stacked overlays restore in reverse order, maximum depth two.
No mouse-only action anywhere, including drag reordering, which always has a ⌘↑↓ equivalent.
Hover never the only way to reveal an action. Row menus visible at rest via icon.subtle, emphasised on focus.
Selection carried by surface.selected plus a checked control, never colour alone. Selection count in a polite live region.
Never disabled without an adjacent stated reason. aria-disabled preferred where the reason must remain readable.
role=grid, full arrow navigation, sort direction announced on activation, sticky headers that do not trap focus.
aria-rowcount reflects the full match count, not the rendered window. Rows carry aria-rowindex.
combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant listbox; focus trapped and restored; destructive entries never the default highlighted row.
Complementary landmark with an accessible name; section headers are real headings; collapse state announced.
Polite for success, selection counts and job progress. Assertive for errors and scope changes. Nothing announces more than once per action.
Announced as a suggestion with its confidence, never as a value. Never focus-stealing. Accept and reject reachable without leaving the field.
Every clip carries a written gloss and plain-language description as required metadata. Missing gloss fails pre-publish validation as blocking.
Keyboard scrub, frame-step, loop region, 0.25× speed floor. No autoplay anywhere.
Pose overlays always have a table equivalent. The overlay is never the only representation of the data.
Status is glyph plus label. Matrix cells carry glyph plus word. Metric deltas carry sign and unit as text. Palette verified against three dichromacy simulations.
Any element using a viz.* fill states its value as text beside it.
prefers-reduced-motion collapses all transforms; opacity capped at 80ms. Nothing loops. No layout-shifting animation in data views.
Usable to 200% zoom and at OS large-text settings. Relative units; no fixed-height text containers.
Mouse, trackpad, touch and pen. 44px hit areas on touch. Below bp.sm the product degrades to read-and-review with a stated reason.
All spacing uses logical properties. RTL is a document attribute, not a stylesheet fork.
Every contrast rule above holds in dark with the remapped tokens. Elevation is expressed by surface lightness, not shadow.

openDecisions.name: Duplicate merge workflow
openDecisions.source: Sayva Studio Scale Review.dc.html Q6, Sayva Studio Handoff Audit.dc.html O1
openDecisions.why: Deciding two signs are the same requires both glosses, both media sets and both usage graphs at once. Which gloss survives, what happens to the losing media, and whether lesson references are rewritten or redirected are linguistic and data-integrity decisions, not layout ones.
openDecisions.affects: An L3 workbench screen, a merge operation in the entity action registry, reference-rewriting in the backend, and the sign.duplicate advisory rule's resolution path — which currently says "merge or dismiss" with no merge to point at.
openDecisions.decidedBy: Sign language linguist plus data owner. Design follows the decision, not the other way round.
doNot: Do not invent a merge UI
Do not implement it as a generic CRUD operation

openDecisions.name: Uncontracted components
openDecisions.why: Seventeen components have a one-line register entry and no contract. Five screen briefs depend on them. A one-line entry is not implementable — it has no variants, no states, no keyboard, no absence behaviour.
openDecisions.affects: Media, Model registry, Validation, Release and Health cannot be built beyond their shell. Phase 1 is unaffected because none of them are in its scope.
openDecisions.decidedBy: Design, one screen at a time. Contracting a component before its workspace is designed produces a guess.
openDecisions.timing: Each one before the screen that needs it.

openDecisions.name: Approximate counts above 10,000
openDecisions.why: Correct engineering that may read as imprecision to editors. "~12,400 match" is honest; whether professionals trust it is an empirical question, and buying exact counts at that scale has a real cost.
openDecisions.affects: SyCollection footer copy and the count query strategy. Reversible, but the threshold should be evidence-based rather than a round number.
openDecisions.decidedBy: Product, from user testing. The 10,000 threshold is currently a guess.

openDecisions.name: Walk working-set cap of 200
openDecisions.why: The cap should come from how many decisions a reviewer actually makes in a sitting, not from a number that sounded reasonable. Too low is an irritation; too high recreates the unbounded-queue problem A3 solved.
openDecisions.affects: The queue cursor implementation and the "next batch" affordance. Trivial to change, worth measuring.

openDecisions.name: CONFLICT — compact row height
openDecisions.source: Sayva Studio Foundations.dc.html §15 vs Sayva Studio Design System.dc.html density prop
openDecisions.why: Foundations §15 states 28px; the Design System density prop states 26px. Both documents are canonical.
openDecisions.affects: SyCollection density modes and every drawn grid.
openDecisions.decidedBy: Design owner must pick one. Not resolved by extraction.

openDecisions.name: CONFLICT — reclassified component count
openDecisions.source: Sayva Studio Handoff Audit.dc.html §03 vs Sayva Studio Design System.dc.html
openDecisions.why: The audit and the handoff state 4 reclassified components. Enumerating them yields 5: SyPackBuilder, SyReleaseComposer, SyCoverageMatrix, SyRuleResult, SyProvenanceTag. Discovered during extraction.
openDecisions.affects: Component counts in the audit only. No implementation impact.
openDecisions.decidedBy: Design. Likely SyPackBuilder and SyReleaseComposer were counted as one line because both map to SyPipeline.

openDecisions.name: Sign variants modelling
openDecisions.why: Variants are modelled as children of a sign. If variants turn out to need independent lifecycles and review, this becomes a peer relationship.
openDecisions.affects: Domain model, Variants tab, validation rules.

openDecisions.name: Cross-language work
openDecisions.why: Aligning an ASL concept to its ArSL equivalent does not fit cleanly inside a language-scoped shell. The scope bar's All languages mode is the escape hatch, but it is untested.
openDecisions.affects: SyAppShell scope bar, SyPalette global mode.

openDecisions.name: Field-level permissions
openDecisions.why: Permissions are sketched at role level only. Field-level permissions, if required, will pressure the inspector's layout.
